title: Supreme Court green lights shifting Uttarakhand HC to Haldwani; sets aside direction to hold referendum
description: The Supreme Court of India on Wednesday gave permission to the State of Uttarakhand to go ahead with its proposal to shift the Uttarakhand High Court from Nainital to Haldwani [High Court Bar Association vs State of Uttarakhand and ors].A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V Mohana also set aside a Uttarakhand High Court order directing a referendum among lawyers and litigants to decide whether the High Court should be shifted from Nainital to a
